unit_policy.scope: unit review; does not certify integration/release

tiers.docs_config: No executable/runtime effect: complete diff/criteria review, syntax/schema/reference consistency and independent discriminating structural probe.
tiers.bounded_code: Affected tests/callers, scoped lint and applicable doctor; independent focused probe or representative valid sabotage; validate every maker guard proof.
tiers.high_risk: Auth/permissions, secrets, PII/image privacy, production/write approvals, destructive controls, shared schema/provider/enforcement: independent focused checks of each affected boundary and rejection paths; mandatory integration gate.

unit_policy.evidence_reuse: Validate immutable base/head, all changed files, commands/results/output hashes, clean-tree binding and environment/dependency/fixture/config identity; stale/incompatible/missing evidence cannot satisfy a claim.
unit_policy.fresh_context_packet: qa/loop.md D-100 minimal packet; checker helper preflight or explicit equivalent checks required.

integration_gate.reuse: Compatible attested candidate evidence may be reused; changed candidate invalidates affected evidence.

efficiency.missing: unknown; ratio unverified; fixed small bootstrap scope in qa/loop.md
efficiency.overrun: NEEDS_EXTRA_REVIEW with reason, scope and estimate; recorded allocation before extra review; HUMAN_GATE only when owner decision required; never autoPASS.

unit_policy.proof: C7 maker proof for all introduced guards/rewritten tests retained; checker independent representative rerun plus risk-driven checks.

done._note: D-100: Done = selected unit-policy evidence plus all unit contract criteria judged PASS by independent /checker. Combined integration/release additionally requires verify.commands on the exact candidate. No production deploy exists; deploy remains separately gated.

parallel.note: Headed browser tests must be serialized (one visible Chromium at a time); the full pytest suite (about 31 minutes) has been killed by memory pressure on this 24 GB machine, so code slots also shrink with free RAM. The 6c sharded full suite holds the machine-wide suite lock and is not counted here.

_notes.parallel: code: test/build slots, at most 4 and at most floor((free GB - 1.5) / 2); browser: one headed browser at a time, 1.1 GB per browser (measured in D:/hei-sweep on this machine, not re-measured here). No mongo_read, mongo_write or search lane: this project has no Mongo and no single-IP search run.
